title: Why the Corvette Z06 Beats the 911 GT3 RS (And Where It Loses)
description:
The Chevrolet Corvette Z06 has more power than a Porsche nine eleven G T three R S. It gets to sixty miles per hour faster. It costs about half as much. So why is the Porsche more than twenty seconds faster around the Nürburgring, and why do used ones sell for more than they cost new, while used Z06s sell for less? That is what we are going to explain. These two cars are the most famous track-focused sports cars from America and Germany. Both use naturally aspirated engines that rev past eight thousand r p m. Both put their engines behind the driver, but in very different places. And both were built with racing in mind.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
